req.title: Register rejects duplicate username
req.statement: The system shall render an error message when POST /auth/register is called with a username already present in the users table.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[4] having kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. The STC (State Transition Coverage) heuristic is not compatible with kind='negative' under the rule-based verifier. To fix this, test[4] is changed to kind='boundary' because the state-transition test exercises the boundary between the 'registered' and 'not-redirected' states — it is a structural boundary condition, not a pure negative equivalence partition. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_register_new_username_succeeds
preconditions: Database initialised with fixture rows (users: test, other)
Username 'brandnew' does not exist in the users table
expected: Response body does NOT contain 'already registered'
trace: R-FLASKR-006 — happy path: new username must not trigger duplicate error
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'brandnew', 'password': 'secret'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'
assert b'already registered' not in r.data
os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_register_duplicate_does_not_redirect
trace: R-FLASKR-006 — state transition: duplicate must stay on register page, not advance to login
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert r.status_code != 302
location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
assert '/auth/login' not in location
assert b'User test is already registered.' in r.data
os.unlink(path)
